mostWorthwhile.text: Linking the wings to the follower was most worthwhile: the explanation showed how the rods turn the wings when the follower rises.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the tail was the least informative passage; it moved the assembly along but gave little explanation.

surprise.text: The new cam produced wave-wave, pause, wave-wave rather than simply describing two evenly spaced waves.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; each action followed a concrete construction goal.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see where Jo's fair stalls go, although the guided fittings themselves were quite predictable.
